title: Germany, Vietnam discuss co-operation in sustainable manufacturing
content:
Germany is committed to supporting Vietnam's green transition through technology transfer, knowledge sharing and long-term business cooperation, a recent bilateral business forum was told.
Participants agreed that sustainable manufacturing now extends beyond environmental concerns to encompass digitalisation, data management and end-to-end supply chain optimisation.

title: South Asia’s growth expected to soften to 6.3% in 2026: World Bank
content:
Growth in South Asia is likely to soften to 6.3 per cent in 2026, mainly reflecting the adverse impact of the Iran war, the World Bank Group’s Global Economic Prospects report said.
Improved access to major trading partners, as well as lower US tariffs, is anticipated to contribute to the stronger export performance.
Excluding India, growth in the region is forecast to rise to 4 per cent in 2026.

title: Karnataka's Kalaburagi PM MITRA park to begin phase-I groundwork
content:
Groundwork for the first phase of the proposed PM MITRA textile park near Kalaburagi in India’s Karnataka state will commence soon, according to the state’s home, information technology, biotechnology and e-governance minister Priyank Kharge.
The infrastructure blueprint and administrative framework for the initial phase of the project have been finalised, he said, after reviewing its progress recently.
